headline: Foreign Exchange Reserves in July 2026 Reach US$145.3 Billion, BI: Equivalent to Financing 5.5 Months of Imports
summary: Bank Indonesia said foreign exchange reserves reached US$145.3 billion at the end of July 2026. The level is equivalent to financing 5.5 months of imports.
why: Foreign exchange reserves are the central bank's stock of foreign currency assets, used to stabilise the local currency and cover external obligations. Reserve levels are a key indicator of an economy's external resilience.
